jobs.label: Consume Verified Model Exchange Research Artifacts
Collect Odds at the Next Budgeted Checkpoint
Freeze $1,000 Shadow Experiment Decisions
Refresh Live Scoreboard (MLB)
Refresh Finals, Settle Positions, Recalculate Performance
Generate NFL M1 Early/Current Research-Shadow Forecasts
Generate NFL M1 Final-Pregame Research-Shadow Forecasts
Import NFL FINAL Forecast and Eligibility Pair
Collect NFL Pregame Odds (one object, near the checkpoint)
Evaluate the NFL Paper Policy at its Final-Pregame Checkpoint
Collect NFL In-Game Scores From ESPN's Free Public Scoreboard (display only)
Ingest NFL Final Scores (nflverse, no cost)
Collect CFB Moneylines From The Odds API (h2h, one request per kickoff cluster; off by default)
Evaluate the CFB Paper Policy at its Final-Pregame Checkpoint
Admit CFB Finals From Retained Evidence and Score CFB Forecasts (no network)
Generate NHL Gen1 Forecasts In-Process From the Public Schedule (frozen model; off by default)
Collect NHL Moneylines From The Odds API (h2h, one request per start-time cluster; off by default)
Evaluate the NHL Paper Checkpoint and Settle NHL Positions
Ingest NHL Finals From ESPN's Free Public Scoreboard (results for NHL settlement; off by default)
Evaluate the NBA Paper Policy at its Final-Pregame Checkpoint (off by default)
